verified_title: OMoE: Diversifying Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation by Orthogonal Finetuning
saved_takeaway: Per-token Gram-Schmidt across LoRA expert output vectors, with a learned router. It is inter-expert response orthogonalization, not an independent orthogonal frame applied to both graph endpoints before their product. Orthogonal expert diversity is prior; graph adaptation cannot claim that principle. Printed Eq7 removes projections but has no normalization, despite claiming unit Stiefel columns. Do not port its displayed formula as a qualified implementation or inherit an optimality guarantee.

verified_title: HousE: Knowledge Graph Embedding with Householder Parameterization
saved_takeaway: Relation-specific Householder reflection products rotate head embeddings; invertible modified reflections create different head/tail relation projections, then distance scores links. Compact Householder graph-endpoint transforms and vector-operation computation are direct prior. Our proposed member-specific same-frame pre-Hadamard adaptation differs at the complete operation, not at the matrix principle. Universal rotation and relation-pattern theorems were exposed, not independently certified.

verified_title: Generalizing Knowledge Graph Embedding with Universal Orthogonal Parameterization
saved_takeaway: GoldE uses quadratic-metric Householder transformations for relation-specific graph link scores; the Euclidean specialization and efficient vector computation already include the normalized nonunit-axis form. Graph-specific norm-preserving endpoint transformations are prior. The proposed one-reflection member frame is a restricted attributed adaptation and not a new orthogonal parameterization.
